title: Fees, tariff schedules and precise monetary calculation
workflow: Define service and applicability against product terms
Select exact currency and decimal rounding conventions
Specify fee base, exemptions, tiers and caps
Assess tax, legal disclosure and accounting mapping dependencies
Obtain maker-checker and customer notice approvals
Produce auditable calculation, then authorized posting request
invariants: Fee computation does not directly modify account balance
Posted charges require authorized balanced journals
Exemptions and reversals are explicit versioned financial events
Tax calculation is disabled until jurisdictional source review
Fee plan changes cannot retroactively edit charged amounts
Disclosure and posting amount reconcile to same approved tariff version
planned_tests: Tier boundaries yield deterministic exact result
Tax without approved policy fails closed
approval_gate: CFO/treasury pricing review, verified tax obligations, account/ledger mappings and executable money tests.
